g.text: Amber outline: 404 audio descriptions. Filled teal: a 2-million-word sample of the One Billion Word benchmark.

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5c6470

g.text: 69,714 AD content tokens against 1,911,249 benchmark tokens, both lemmatised with the same pipeline · the benchmark is news prose, so this is a genre contrast, not a comparison with English in the abstract · every difference is significant at p < 1e-10 on n this large, so read the effect sizes, not the p-values
